name: Elemental Adaptation
description: When casting a damaging Arcane spell, you may burn any card to change its damage type to another appropriate elemental type.

name: Potent Cantrip
description: When you cast a Tier 0 damaging spell in combat, you may burn any card to enhance the spell. If the spell hits, it deals 1 additional HP of damage.

name: Dark Resonance
description: All Face cards are also Diamonds in additional to their shown suit. When determining the outcome of an effect, the card can only use one suit.

name: Spell Shaping
description: When casting an area or multi-target spell, you may exclude one appropriate target from the spell's effect.

name: Overchannel
description: When casting a damaging Arcane spell, you may burn up to two additional cards of any suit to increase the spell's damage by +1 HP per card.

name: Arcane Penetration
description: Your damaging Arcane spells may partially bypass an enemy's magical resistance. The GM determines how much resistance is overcome based on the creature and spell.

name: Focused Casting
description: Once per Short Rest when you cast an Arcane spell requiring a magic attack, you may attack at advantage before determining whether the spell hits.

name: Master of Elements
description: You may freely change the elemental damage type of your Arcane damaging spells without requiring a special circumstance, provided the new damage type is appropriate to the spell.

name: Arcane Mastery
description: Once per short rest, when casting an Arcane spell of Tier 3 or higher, you may reduce the spell's casting cost by 1 card. The remaining cards must still be paid normally.

name: Distracting Illusion
description: Create an illusion that distracts an enemy. When an illusion is close to an enemy it has disadvantage on its next attack.

name: Illusory Disguise
description: Burn any card, create a magical disguise that changes your apparent appearance. The disguise lasts until the end of the scene or until closely examined.

name: Phantom Double
description: Extend the distance of your Illusory Twin and you don't need to remain within sight.

name: Illusory Terrain
description: Burn any card and create an illusion that changes the apparent appearance of an area. The illusion can conceal doors, create apparent obstacles, disguise paths, or make an area appear dangerous.

name: Misdirection
description: When an enemy targets you with an attack, as a reaction you may burn a card to create a momentary illusion to redirect the attack, imposing a disadvantage.

name: Illusory Escape
description: Once per short rest, when you would be hit by an attack, you may burn a card to create an illusion of yourself in your current position and move to a nearby location.

name: Reality Swap
description: Burn a Face Card to Swap Positions with your Illusory Twin.

name: Master of Deception
description: Gain proficiency in Deception or Stealth.

name: Grand Illusion
description: Once per long rest, create a powerful illusion capable of affecting an entire scene. The illusion may disguise a location, create convincing creatures or hazards, or radically alter how the area appears. The GM determines its exact limits.
